transcript:
user: What is a write-ahead log?
assistant: A write-ahead log records a change before it is applied to the data pages, so a crash can be recovered by replaying the log. That is what makes durability possible without flushing every page on every commit.
required_points: changes are logged before being applied
a crash is recovered by replaying the log
notes: Short, so there is little to summarise and maximum temptation to pad. The forbidden claims are true-but-absent facts a model reaches for, and being true is what makes them dangerous.
